scope: Proposition 12.4 (Projectivity-orbit classification) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 150-151. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On almost every sharp endpoint fibre, the one-copy real pencil measurements are evaluations of random homogeneous diffeomorphisms ARITHMETICITY OF TWISTED FINITE CORRESPONDENCES 151 from the source pencil onto the target pencil. The maps and their inverses have jointly measurable versions as the endpoint fibres vary. Their evaluations recover the original PVMs at every fixed source label.
